g.text: Old 1,713-row primary and new 48-row secondary · raw target · 217 features · 300 trees · five joint closed folds · all three paired seeds
Declared primary, augmented − control: +0.284232 LUT4 across the three paired seeds. Negative favors augmentation.
B/D bars show descriptive seed means and dots show all three contrasts. C uses pooled MAE within each family, not a reweighted primary.
Targeted consumed-development experiment: both views use the same joint closed validation groups; no linked new validation row enters augmentation training.

Old 1,713 rows remain the primary denominator. New 48 results are secondary; no selected seed, confidence interval, fresh-transfer, calibration or CPU claim. Full precision and hashes: figure-data.json.
